content.text:
**Finding: NOSOLICIT — compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-inducement covenant on The Deerskin Companies (or on HDI). This satisfies our preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so no redline is proposed.

Investigation trail:
- Term searches: "solicit", "employ or engage hire employees", "induce to leave employment", "personnel staff recruit" — all nil.
- Full read of every section (sec-p0001, sec-1.4, sec-5.4, sec-p0072) and the planner's flagged §5.4 (General Manager appointment) — no personnel covenant sits nearby.
- Only employee references are the confidentiality carve-out (p0051) and the no-joint-venture clause (p0061); neither restricts recruiting or hiring.
- Integration clause (p0069) confirms no non-solicit is imported from any prior agreement.

Noted, not flagged here: §6.1/§6.3 exclusivity and HDI's two-year post-term restraint on similar projects are competitive/brand restraints and belong to the exclusivity rule, not this one — so they are not double-flagged.
